title: WorkFlow Space: Branch Launch Performance
summary: End-to-end paid launch campaigns for two new branches, generating 2,000+ qualified leads and 4M+ impressions with a ~VND 300M budget.
description:
Led performance marketing campaigns for new WorkFlow Space branch launches in Go Vap and District 8, managing approximately VND 300M in paid media budget.

Generated 2,000+ qualified leads and 4M+ impressions across launch campaigns while coordinating paid media, landing pages, and creative production.

Rebranded the visual identity and designed conversion-optimized landing pages for paid campaigns, driving 400+ website leads per month at a 35-40% conversion rate.

Oversaw production of 200+ creative assets and improved CTR by more than 70% through data-driven creative optimization.
